column2: Send more supporting troops to increase the size of [From.GetFirstName]'s band.

[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFOA],
My men and I have had trouble finding a battlefield where our expertise could be employed for payment in gold, and unfortunately our rations are now running low. I therefore request additional funding to keep the men from starving.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
I'll cover the cost for extra rations.
Starvation might serve as a lesson to [From.GetHerHim].

[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFOA],
The money you sent was well needed. However we had to spend the whole lot of it on food. We could need some better equipment to have better chances of success once we reach the battlefield. Equipment is rather expensive for our empty purse and I know that you will see the benefit of such an investment.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledFirstName]
I'll send a contribution at once.
I can't spare you a single coin.
Remind [From.GetFirstName] of [From.GetHerHis] obligations.

[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFOA],
War is a harsh business and the soldiers are demanding more money. I have no regrets informing you that this money will come from your cut, since it's the people fighting that are doing all the work and not the people sitting on high chairs.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledFirstName]

Your mercenary band captain [From.GetTitledName] has shown much interest in your [chosen_child.GetSonDaughter] [chosen_child.GetFirstName]. Now [From.GetSheHe] approaches you with a marriage proposal. Any children in such a marriage would be of [From.GetTitledName]'s dynasty.
Not a bad idea.
Outrageous!

[From.GetFullName] proposes that we send more troops making them a bigger, better mercenary band. [From.GetSheHeCap] insists that with the experience [From.GetSheHe] has gained, trusting [From.GetHerHim] with a greater force is a natural way of showing mutual respect and trust.
Accept proposal.
Respectfully disagree.
[From.GetFullName] was not happy with your decision to dissolve '[From.GetHerHis]' mercenary band. [From.GetSheHeCap] is reported to have taken your soldiers as [From.GetHerHis] own and disappeared.
When I find [From.GetHerHim]...
Who knows what they will be up to.

To the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetTitledFirstName].\n\nMy men and I have put up with your leeching of our abilities for too long now. You failed to treat us with the proper respect on multiple occasions and therefore we will from now on pay no respect or allegiance towards you. It will be my pleasure to aid your enemies to defeat your armies on the battlefield.
That ungrateful [GetRootFromInsult]!
Collect an 'extra' tax from the peasants of [extra_tax_target.GetName].

The money for that War Chest is not going to raise itself! You have decided to take matters into your own hands and see to that the chest gets filled to the brim with 'donations' from your loyal subjects. How should you proceed?
The peasants of [extra_tax_target.GetName] can pay an extra tax!
[extortion_target.GetFullName] is wealthy, [extortion_target.GetSheHe] can part with some gold!
The clergy of [seize_church_target.GetName] surely does not need all that wealth!
Maybe this is a bad idea after all...

The peasants of [extra_tax_target.GetName] did, as expected, not appreciate the 'extra' tax we forced upon them. The peasants even elected a leader amongst them who started asking questions why this tax was necessary, and exclaimed that they would now have to starve! Perhaps something should be done before they get the pitchforks?
Explain how this tax is necessary, and give them a temporary tax relief.
The tax is obviously necessary, the peasants are just greedy!
Use brute force to extort [extortion_target.GetFullName].

Even though you have explained it in detail to [extortion_target.GetFirstName], [extortion_target.GetSheHe] still does not understand why you are plundering [extortion_target.GetHerHis] mansion. It would seem evident that giving up some of your wealth in support of the realm is the right thing to do, but [extortion_target.GetFirstName] is having none of it.
Apologize and explain how this will help save the realm.
Why, you should be honored by me letting you contribute this much!
Order your men to seize the wealth of the [seize_church_target.GetFullName].

As your men load the wealth of the [seize_church_target.GetFullName] onto several wagons, you are approached by a raving group of clergymen. Apparently they are not too happy about you seizing their valuable idols, they claim that you will be punished by [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] if you cannot justify this blasphemy!
[Root.Religion.GetRandomGodNameCap] told me that this had to be done!
[Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodNameCap] be damned, the wealth does more good in my coffers!

Your loyal vassal, [From.GetFullName], has sent you a courier with an offer. [From.GetSheHeCap] is willing to make a significant donation to your War Chest, but in return you must promise to return the favor in the future. A most generous offer!
This is just what we need!
[From.GetSheHeCap] is just trying to gain leverage on me! I refuse.
A generous donation from a good friend!
[From.GetFullName] has decided to accept your donation offer! Now we have leverage on [From.GetHerHim], we must make sure to use it wisely.
[From.GetFullName] has refused your generous donation offer. [From.GetSheHeCap] claims that you are just trying to gain leverage on [From.GetHerHim], outrageous!
A shame.
Of course the men should be rewarded generously.
Let them keep a little of the money.
I need to remind [From.GetName] that this would be a breach of contract.
